question: What do we call a very dry place that is covered with lots of sand? 🐪
explanation: Super! A desert is a unique place that is very hot, dry, and filled with sand! 🐪
hint: This place gets very little rain.

question: Which animal is known as the Ship of the Desert? 🐫
explanation: Awesome! Camels can walk easily on sand and go without water for days, so they are called the Ship of the Desert! 🐫
hint: This animal has a hump on its back.

question: Which plant grows perfectly in a hot and dry desert? 🌵
explanation: Great job! A cactus loves the desert because it can store water inside its thick stem! 🌵
hint: This plant has sharp prickly thorns.

question: What does a camel store in the big hump on its back? 🐪
explanation: Brilliant! The hump stores fat, which gives the camel energy when there is no food around! 🐪
hint: It is a type of stored energy, not water.

question: What do we call a beautiful small pond of water found in a desert? 🌴
explanation: Fantastic! An oasis is a magical spot of water and green trees right in the middle of a sandy desert! 🌴
hint: It starts with the letter 'O'.

question: How does the weather feel in a desert during the daytime? ☀️
explanation: Super! Because there are no clouds and lots of sun, the desert gets very hot during the day! ☀️
hint: You would sweat a lot there!

question: What kind of special feet help a camel walk on loose sand? 🐾
explanation: Awesome! Camels have wide, padded feet that stop them from sinking into the soft sand! 🐾
hint: They act like soft, flat cushions.

question: Why do cactus plants have sharp thorns instead of big leaves? 🌵
explanation: Great job! Big leaves lose water quickly, so cactuses have thin thorns to save their water! 🌵
hint: It helps them stay wet inside.

question: What do we call a very high place that reaches up to the clouds? ⛰️
explanation: Brilliant! Mountains are huge, tall lands that go way up into the sky! ⛰️
hint: Climbing this can be very tiring.

question: Which large animal with long, thick hair lives on snowy mountains? 🐂
explanation: Super! The yak has a thick coat of long hair to keep it warm in the freezing cold mountains! 🐂
hint: It looks a bit like a big, hairy cow.

question: Why do animals living in the snow have thick fur? 🧥
explanation: Fantastic! Just like we wear winter jackets, animals grow thick fur to protect themselves from the cold! 🧥
hint: It acts like a cozy blanket.

question: Which beautiful big cat lives high up in the cold, snowy mountains? 🐆
explanation: Awesome! The snow leopard has a thick tail and warm fur to hunt in the freezing snowy mountains! 🐆
hint: It has 'snow' in its name.

question: What shape do pine trees have so the snow can slide right off? 🌲
explanation: Great job! Pine trees are shaped like a triangle or cone so heavy snow slides off without breaking branches! 🌲
hint: It looks like a birthday hat.

question: What covers the very top of tall mountains in winter? 🏔️
explanation: Super! Because the top of the mountain is so high and cold, rain turns into freezing white snow! 🏔️
hint: It is cold, white, and icy.

question: What kind of clothes must you wear to visit a snowy mountain? 🧣
explanation: Brilliant! Woolen clothes trap our body heat and keep us super warm in the freezing snow! 🧣
hint: Sweaters and mufflers are made of this.

question: What do we call a huge place filled with many tall trees growing close together? 🌳
explanation: Fantastic! A dense forest is packed with tall trees, bushes, and wild animals! 🌳
hint: It is sometimes called a jungle.

question: Which playful animal loves to swing from branch to branch in the forest? 🐒
explanation: Awesome! Monkeys have long arms and tails that help them swing and play in the high forest trees! 🐒
hint: They love eating bananas.

question: Which fierce, striped animal lives in the dense forests of India? 🐅
explanation: Great job! The tiger is our national animal and uses its stripes to hide in the tall forest grass! 🐅
hint: It is an orange cat with black stripes.

question: Why does it look dark inside a very dense forest even during the day? 🍃
explanation: Super! There are so many trees and thick leaves that they block the sunlight from reaching the ground! 🍃
hint: The top part of the trees makes a roof.

question: Which very large animal with a long trunk walks slowly in the forest? 🐘
explanation: Brilliant! The mighty elephant uses its trunk to pull leaves from tall trees in the forest! 🐘
hint: It has big flapping ears.

question: What important thing do forest trees give us to help us breathe? 🌬️
explanation: Fantastic! Trees are amazing because they clean the air and give us fresh oxygen to breathe! 🌬️
hint: We take this inside when we inhale.

question: Which long, legless reptile slithers quietly on the forest floor? 🐍
explanation: Awesome! Snakes use their muscles to slither through the grass and bushes of the forest! 🐍
hint: It goes 'hiss'.

question: What is a piece of land completely surrounded by water called? 🏝️
explanation: Great job! An island is a unique place where you see water no matter which direction you look! 🏝️
hint: You need a boat to reach this place.

question: Which tall tree grows perfectly on the sandy beaches of an island? 🌴
explanation: Super! Coconut trees love the warm weather and sandy soil near the ocean beaches! 🌴
hint: It grows big brown fruits with sweet water inside.

question: What vehicle do we usually use to cross the water and visit an island? ⛴️
explanation: Brilliant! Since an island is surrounded by water, we must use a boat or a ship to reach it! ⛴️
hint: It floats on water.

question: What do we call the huge body of salty water that surrounds an island? 🌊
explanation: Fantastic! Oceans are the biggest bodies of water on Earth, and they are very, very salty! 🌊
hint: Whales and sharks live here.

question: Which smart and friendly animal loves to jump out of the ocean water? 🐬
explanation: Awesome! Dolphins are very intelligent and love to jump and play in the ocean waves! 🐬
hint: It makes clicking and squeaking sounds.

question: What soft yellow thing do we play with and build castles with on the beach? 🏖️
explanation: Great job! The beach is covered in soft sand where we can run, play, and build fun castles! 🏖️
hint: It gets inside your shoes at the beach.

question: What do we call a forest that gets very heavy rain almost every single day? 🌧️
explanation: Super! A rainforest is incredibly green and thick because it receives lots of rain all year round! 🌧️
hint: The name has the word 'rain' in it.

question: Which very slow animal hangs upside down from tree branches all day? 🦥
explanation: Brilliant! Sloths move extremely slowly to save their energy and spend most of their lives hanging in trees! 🦥
hint: It is famous for being the slowest animal.

question: What do we call a large area of flat and grassy land? 🛤️
explanation: Fantastic! Plains are flat, open lands that are perfect for growing crops and building houses! 🛤️
hint: It is not bumpy or high.

question: What falls from the sky to give forests the water they need to stay green? 🌧️
explanation: Awesome! Plants and trees drink up the falling rainwater to grow tall and stay healthy! 🌧️
hint: You need an umbrella for this.

question: Which bright and colorful bird can learn to mimic human words? 🦜
explanation: Great job! Parrots are clever, colorful birds living in tropical forests that can learn to talk like us! 🦜
hint: It is often green with a red beak.

question: Which big fish with sharp teeth lives deep in the ocean waters? 🦈
explanation: Super! Sharks are incredible ocean hunters with rows of very sharp teeth! 🦈
hint: It has a fin on its back.

question: What do we call a piece of high land that is flat on the top like a table? 🏜️
explanation: Brilliant! A plateau is raised high like a mountain but has a flat, open top! 🏜️
hint: It is sometimes called a tableland.

question: Which animal has a super long neck to eat leaves from the tops of trees? 🦒
explanation: Fantastic! The giraffe is the tallest land animal, using its long neck to reach the yummiest high leaves! 🦒
hint: It has brown spots on its coat.

question: What do we call the low land sitting right between two tall mountains? 🏞️
explanation: Awesome! A valley is a beautiful, V-shaped or U-shaped low area between mountains, often with a river! 🏞️
hint: Rivers often flow through here.

question: Which cute bird wearing a 'tuxedo' loves swimming in freezing ice water? 🐧
explanation: Great job! Penguins cannot fly in the air, but they are amazing swimmers in the icy cold oceans! 🐧
hint: It waddles when it walks on ice.

question: What kind of water fills the massive oceans around our islands? 🌊
explanation: Super! Ocean water has lots of salt dissolved in it, so we cannot drink it! 🌊
hint: It tastes like tears.

question: Where do massive white polar bears love to live? 🐻‍❄️
explanation: Brilliant! Polar bears live in the freezing Arctic, using their thick white fur to stay warm! 🐻‍❄️
hint: They live where there is lots of ice.

question: Which tiny, buzzing insect visits flowers to make sweet honey? 🐝
explanation: Fantastic! Honeybees collect nectar from colorful forest flowers to make delicious honey! 🐝
hint: It is yellow and black and goes 'buzz'.

question: What is the tallest type of grass that giant pandas love to munch on? 🎋
explanation: Awesome! Bamboo grows incredibly fast in forests and is the absolute favorite food of pandas! 🎋
hint: It has green, hollow stems.

question: What do we call a sticky place filled with very wet mud and shallow water? 🐊
explanation: Great job! A swamp is a wetland where trees grow right out of the muddy water! 🐊
hint: Crocodiles love hiding here.

question: Which heavy animal loves sitting in swamp water to keep its skin cool? 🦛
explanation: Super! Hippos spend all day in the water or mud to protect their sensitive skin from the hot sun! 🦛
hint: It has a massive mouth and teeth.

question: What precious and shiny white gem hides inside some sea shells? 🦪
explanation: Brilliant! Oysters make beautiful round pearls inside their shells deep in the ocean water! 🦪
hint: It is round, smooth, and shiny white.

question: What do birds build high up in the forest trees to keep their eggs safe? 🪹
explanation: Fantastic! Birds use twigs and leaves to weave cozy nests where their baby chicks can hatch safely! 🪹
hint: It looks like a small bowl of sticks.

question: What beautiful, colorful arch appears in the sky after a forest rain? 🌈
explanation: Awesome! When sunlight shines through tiny raindrops, it creates a magical seven-colored rainbow! 🌈
hint: It has seven bright colors.

question: What is the topmost, pointy part of a snowy mountain called? ⛰️
explanation: Great job! The highest point of a mountain is called its peak, and it is usually freezing cold up there! ⛰️
hint: It is the very tip at the top.

question: Which animal carries a hard shell on its back and moves slowly on the beach? 🐢
explanation: Super! Sea turtles have hard shells for protection and use their flippers to swim in the ocean! 🐢
hint: It hides its head inside when scared.

question: What is the name of our beautiful home planet with all these wondrous places? 🌍
explanation: Brilliant! Earth is our wondrous home, filled with oceans, mountains, forests, and amazing animals! 🌍
hint: It is known as the Blue Planet.
